peer_reviewed_method.title: A flexible deep learning crater detection scheme using Segment Anything Model (SAM)

integration_recommendation: NOT recommended for direct integration yet. The named repo is a minimal demo (README + a single notebook + image archive) with no released weights, no dependency manifest, and no trainable code, so it is not directly usable. The actual peer-reviewed method is the Giannakis et al. 2024 Icarus work, which would need SAM weights from Meta (downloadable) and the paper's shape-index post-processing implemented from scratch, plus a GPU.

segment anything crater detection.description: Crater detection from images using Segment Anything (SAM) + OpenCV. Outputs an annotated image with red circles and a CSV of crater centers/radii.

SAM lunar crater detection.description: Automatic detection of craters on the lunar surface
